title: Form settings
selectHint: Click a question in the form to edit it.
autofillDescription: Turn off if people fill in the form for someone else.
pdfHint: A PDF you can download for every response.
pdfLeaseHint: Fills in the official lease contract. Use the Lease contract template.
redirectHint: Optional. People go to this page after the thank-you message.
stepsEmpty: Add a {pageBreak} to split the form into steps.
navSidebarHint: Steps listed next to the form, with a tick when done.
navTopHint: A progress bar above the form.
firstStepTitleHint: Set the other titles on each page break.
nextTextHint: {next} shows the next step's title, like “{next} →”.
saveDraftDescription: People can leave and come back later on the same device. Adds a “Save and exit” button.
exitUrl: Go to this page when leaving
sendToHint: Optional. Without one, the form sends a {event} event to your page.
bearerHint: Anyone can see this token. Only use one that is meant to be public.
multipartDescription: Used automatically when the form has file uploads.
webhookHint: Gets a POST request if sending fails.
moreInAdvanced: Step options and where responses go are in the advanced view.
afterPageHint: People see a page you build, with text, images, videos or links.
redirectTarget: When the form is embedded in another site
redirectTargetHint: If the browser blocks the redirect, people see a Continue button.
stepHeader: Show each step’s title on its page
stepHeaderHint: The title and description of the step, above its questions.
stepOwnHint: To give a step its own title, picture or button text, click its page break.
stepTransitionHint: Turned off for visitors who prefer less motion.
firstStepImageHint: Shown at the top of the first step.
codeIntro: Your own JavaScript that runs with the form. Use it for things the other settings can't do, like showing a message or checking answers before they are sent.
codeSafety: The code can't read the page, cookies or logins. Test it in Preview.
stepsVisitedHint: People finish each step before moving on. They can always go back.
stepsAnyHint: People can open any step. Everything is checked when they send.
stepsBackOnlyHint: The step list only goes back. People move forward with the button.
codePlaceholder: Write your code here, or insert an example below.
codeExFieldNameHint: Change the field names to the ones of your questions: in the Advanced view, click the question and look for Field name.
codeExHighScore: Thank people who give a high score
codeExHighScoreComment: When someone gives a high score, show a thank-you message.
codeExHighScoreMessage: Thank you! We're glad you like us.
codeExStyle: Colour a question by its answer
codeExStyleComment: When someone gives a low score, colour the question so it stands out.
codeExTodayComment: Fill in today's date when the form opens. People can still change it.
codeExCheckDates: Check that the end date is after the start date
codeExCheckDatesComment: Don't send the form when the end date is before the start date.
codeExCheckDatesMessage: The end date must be after the start date.
codeExRedirect: Open a different page depending on an answer
codeExRedirectComment: After sending, open a page that depends on an answer. Change the addresses to your own pages.
codeExFilter: Only offer options that match an earlier answer
codeExFilterComment: Only offer the options of the second question that contain the answer to the first one.
stepProgressHint: Each step fills up as its required questions are answered.
sidebarSubtitleHint: Type {saved} to show when the answers were last saved.
sidebarSubtitleNoDraft: {saved} shows the last save time when Save progress is on.
sidebarButtonsHint: Add buttons that sit under the step list.
